Sum of negative eigenvalue magnitudes gives the source exact formula; strict convexity in x,z for fixed y>0 forces x=z=(1−y)/2; y=0 has N=1/2. Independent full PT spectral checks on 861 sampled triples agree, but global theorem rests on convexity and derivative positivity, which was independently checked algebraically.
